name: party-panel
title: Party panel
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Profile column with progress, facts, members, files, and sensitive fields masked until reveal.

meta.descriptionEs: Columna de ficha con avance, datos, miembros, archivos y campos sensibles enmascarados hasta mostrarlos.

examples.title: Ficha de la contraparte
examples.description: Columna de ficha con avance, datos, miembros, archivos y campos sensibles enmascarados hasta mostrarlos.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, RTL y cantidad.

meta.usage: <PartyPanel name="Taller Ámbar" deal={{ title: "Marca", status: "Abierto", amount: "$34,600 de $48,000", value: 72, label: "72 %" }} secrets={[{ id: "curp", label: "CURP", masked: "••••", revealed }]} onReveal={audit} />

api.name: deal
api.description: Title, status, amount, and a 0–100 bar. The bar does not animate.

api.name: facts / members / files
api.description: Key values, people, and shared files. Download calls onDownload.

api.name: secrets / onReveal
api.description: Masked by default. Show reveals and calls onReveal with the id only.

api.name: state
api.description: Skeleton, empty copy, or an alert.
